SEARCH
Package org.scilab.forge.jlatexmath

Interface TeXGraphics

All Known Implementing Classes:
UGraphicTeXGraphics
public interface TeXGraphics
The small drawing surface that the boxes need, in place of Graphics2D.

It is exactly the subset of Graphics2D that Box.draw(org.scilab.forge.jlatexmath.TeXGraphics, float, float) and its subclasses use: rectangles, rounded rectangle, lines, one glyph at the origin, the current color, the line width (butt caps, miter joins) and the transformation (translate, scale, rotate, save and restore).

    • drawChar

      void drawChar(int fontId, char c)
      Draws one glyph with its origin (baseline, left) at the current origin. The size is given by the current scale: one unit is TeXFormula.FONT_SCALE_FACTOR font units.

    • drawText

      void drawText(String text, double fontSize)
      Draws text that no TeX font has the glyphs of (see TeXTextMeasurer), with its baseline origin at the current origin. The font size is in the current units, as the size of the glyphs of drawChar(int, char) is. The canvas may not rotate or flip it.
